releases.name: 3.0.1 — enforced candidate menu, per-source chains, comparing gate
releases.notes:
## What changed

3.0.1 closes the gap between what the README promised and what the code enforced. The short version: a Go model id can no longer be invented, chain length follows the source, Markdown agents can actually be written, the mode question is asked once, and `check` re-derives the numbers instead of trusting the file.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#301---2026-11-03) for the full list. The Chinese changelog is at [zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md).

## Install this release

Download **`opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip`** below. It is the minimal package, not the GitHub "source code" archive:

- top-level directory is `opencode-go-model-picker/`
- it contains only `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/` and `LICENSE` — no tests, no docs site, no `assets/`, no `.git`, no `node_modules`
- 18 files

Extract it into your OpenCode skills directory so the folder name matches the skill name:

```bash
unzip opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -d ~/.config/opencode/skills/
```

```powershell
Expand-Archive opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.1-min.zip -DestinationPath "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\skills"
```

Then ask OpenCode to check your agent models. The skill is read-only until you confirm a diff.

en.headline: 22 own commits plus 4 automated across four repositories
en.summary: The day recorded **22 own commits** across three repositories, plus 4 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 10 commits updated knowledge documentation: the bundled skill count was measured at 11, the routing block was rewritten to match 3.0.6 with `librarian` merged into `explorer`, Mermaid escaping was corrected by diagram type, and six articles gained relationship diagrams. The same repository added notes on V2 skill discovery and master-agent orchestration, WorkBuddy session directory encoding, host/CLI boundaries, model integration, and session data, while documenting a user-measured 40%→0.x% result and an unverified Chinese rewrite checklist with side effects. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 6 commits enforced the candidate menu, per-source chains, and a fail-closed comparing check gate, and clarified that caveat wording may be reworded while flagless checks are structural. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 6 commits aligned the v1 plan, added a `starlight-docs` skill design plan, added `--help` and `-h` to install usage, raised the assertion count from 279 to 333 after `scripts/daily/verify.mjs` passed all 333 checks, and documented unknown-argument exit code 3 and `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` parsing order in English and Chinese.

releaseNotes.summary: The release prevents invented Go model IDs, makes chain length follow the source, allows Markdown agents to be written, asks the mode question once, and makes `check` re-derive numbers instead of trusting the file. It also enforces the candidate menu, per-source chains, and a comparing check gate.

zh.headline: 22 次本人提交，另有 4 次自动提交，涉及四个仓库
zh.summary: 当天在三个仓库完成 **22 次本人提交**，另有 4 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 10 次提交更新知识文档：随包 skill 数量实测为 11 个，routing block 按 3.0.6 原文重写并将 `librarian` 并入 `explorer`，Mermaid 转义按图类型修正，6 篇文章补上关系图。该仓库还收录了 V2 技能发现与主从代理编排、WorkBuddy 会话目录编码、宿主与 CLI 边界、模型接入及会话数据实测，并记录用户实测的 40%→0.x% 结果，以及标注未验证与副作用的中文改写降 AI 检测清单。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 的 6 次提交落实候选菜单、按来源链和失败即拦截的比较检查门禁，并说明 caveat 段落可改写、无 flag 检查属于结构性检查。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 6 次提交对齐 v1 计划、新增 `starlight-docs` 通用 skill 设计计划、在安装用法中补充 `--help` 与 `-h`，并在 `scripts/daily/verify.mjs` 实跑 333 项全绿后将断言数从 279 提升到 333，同时以中英双语补充未知参数退出码 3 和 `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` 解析顺序。当天没有 pull request、issue 或 review，也没有发起或参与讨论。

releaseNotes.summary: 该版本禁止自行编造 Go 模型 ID，使链长度跟随来源，允许写入 Markdown agent，只询问一次模式问题，并让 `check` 重新推导数值而不直接信任文件。同时落实候选菜单、按来源链和比较检查门禁。
